rows: Full cycle: same stage and direction. Amplitude \(A\): largest displacement magnitude from equilibrium. Peak-to-peak: \(2A\). Offset \(y_0\): equilibrium position.
\(f=1/T\); \(\omega=2\pi f=2\pi/T\). \(T\) in s, \(f\) in Hz, \(\omega\) in rad/s. One cycle: \(2\pi\) rad.
\(y=y_0+x\); \(x=A\cos(\omega t+\phi)\). Initial phase \(\phi\) in rad. Positive maximum at \(t_p\): \(\phi=-\omega t_p\) modulo \(2\pi\).
\(v=-A\omega\sin(\omega t+\phi)\); \(a=-\omega^2x\). Maximum speed \(A\omega\); maximum acceleration magnitude \(A\omega^2\).
\(F=-kx\), \(\omega=\sqrt{k/m}\), \(T=2\pi\sqrt{m/k}\). Linear spring, fixed support, negligible damping and spring mass; \(k>0,m>0\).
\(E=\tfrac12mv^2+\tfrac12kx^2=\tfrac12kA^2\) for the horizontal undamped model. \(|v|=\sqrt{(k/m)(A^2-x^2)}\); direction needs cycle stage.
Free damping removes oscillatory mechanical energy. Steady driving balances loss per cycle. Lightly damped displacement resonance peaks near the undamped natural frequency.
\(\Delta t=1/f_s\), \(t_n=n/f_s\). Samples per cycle: \(f_s/f\). \(N\) intervals have \(N+1\) endpoints. Record actual duration.
For \(x_i\le0<x_{i+1}\): \(t_c=t_i+\frac{-x_i}{x_{i+1}-x_i}(t_{i+1}-t_i)\). Subtract equilibrium offset first; linear interpolation.
\(\widehat T=(c_{q-1}-c_0)/(q-1)\), \(q\ge2\) upward crossings. Inspect individual intervals; too few crossings means no estimate.
Distinct motions can share samples. Use \(f_s>2f_{\max}\) with a justified signal-frequency bound; equality is unsafe. Graph/crossing estimates need resolution and duration checks.
Model benchmark checks implementation; independent observations test physical predictions. More samples at an unchanged aliasing rate need not resolve ambiguity.
